models.name: SatQuery-VQA-Pro
models.architecture: Vision-Language Remote Sensing Transformer with LoRA (r=16, alpha=32)

models.name: SatQuery-ChangeDet-Siamese
models.supportedInput: Co-registered T1 and T2 GeoTIFFs (Sentinel-2 / Landsat)

models.name: SatQuery-ChangeVQA-Temporal
models.supportedInput: T1 & T2 Image Pair + Natural Language Query

models.name: SatQuery-OpticalSAR-DeepFusion
models.adaptationDataset: BigEarthNet.txt (co-registered S1 SAR + S2 MSI multi-modal pairs)
models.architecture: Cross-Attention Dual-Stream Encoder with Physical Microwave Invariance

benchmarks.name: VRSBench
benchmarks.task: Visual Grounding, Captioning & VQA for High-Res Remote Sensing
benchmarks.description: Comprehensive open-source benchmark for visual question answering, dense captioning, and bounding-box spatial grounding on sub-meter satellite imagery.
benchmarks.citation: VRSBench: A Versatile Vision-Language Benchmark for Remote Sensing

benchmarks.name: RSVQA (Low/High Resolution)
benchmarks.description: Standard remote sensing VQA benchmark targeting presence, comparison, and rural/urban land-cover counting questions over Sentinel-2 and aerial images.
benchmarks.citation: RSVQA: Visual Question Answering for Remote Sensing Data

benchmarks.name: CDVQA Benchmark
benchmarks.description: Bi-temporal question answering benchmark evaluating reasoning over structural land-use changes, building expansions, and environmental degradation.
benchmarks.citation: CDVQA: Change Detection Visual Question Answering Benchmark

benchmarks.name: BigEarthNet.txt (Multimodal)
benchmarks.description: Primary dataset for remote-sensing adaptation using co-registered Sentinel-1 SAR, Sentinel-2 multispectral imagery, and diverse text annotations (arXiv:2603.29630).
benchmarks.sampleCount: 590,326 co-registered pairs with rich textual descriptions
benchmarks.satQueryScore: 91.8% Macro F1 on 19 CORINE land-cover classes
benchmarks.citation: BigEarthNet.txt: Co-registered Multimodal SAR-MSI Dataset with Textual Supervision (arXiv:2603.29630)
